list.text: Seafoam Islands
...Somebody put a notice under the sign!
The Cinnabar Gym has moved here.\nLeader: Blaine
I used to be a fisherman a while back.
I've grown to love swimming so much, I'm always in my swim trunks!
Maybe I should go back to fishing...
What an impressive collection of Gym Badges. We should battle!
Surf is no longer the only HM move you use in water.
I feel so much lighter in water.
Swimming exercises your full body.\nIt's really good for you.
This is where I train my bird Pokemon.

lines: EndSpeech: Oh, não!nAgora o que irei fazer?

list.text: My birds are too tired to fly back home!
Look! It's my best swimsuit and my very best Pokemon!

lines: EndSpeech: Oh, não!nMinhas jóias estavam ali!

list.text: Your Pokemon--are you following the latest trend in teams?
Look how good my shape is!
Told you to look my shape, not my Pokémon!
I guess it's impossible to swim all the way to Johto.
Besides the sea. I can also swim in ponds and rivers.
Yo! Legend in the making!
Blaine Gym's is here since the Volcano erupted in Cinnabar, I'm sure it won't be easy to beat him!
The Gym Leader rebuilding his Gym and the Trainer from Johto who has come to challenge that Gym Leader...
I have witnessed a hot battle!
Yo! Legend in the making!
The Gym Leader is not here now.
All the Gym Leaders are in Celadon for the Pokémon Association elections.
